slides.title: The early starter.
slides.body: Goes on two. Swears they heard go. Four reps up and fooling nobody.

slides.title: The collar fixer.
slides.body: Clock's running. Still fixing the collar. Still fixing the collar.

slides.title: The last sip.
slides.body: Drink at three. Drink at two. Somehow still thirsty at go.

slides.title: The co-host.
slides.body: Counts down with the coach. Louder than the coach. Slightly ahead of the coach.

slides.title: The ritual.
slides.body: Chalk, clap, grip, regrip, chalk again. Misses the first ten seconds every time.

slides.title: The statue.
slides.body: Doesn't move a muscle on three, two, one. On go, they're simply gone.
